15.t: Working with data: densities of materials
q: Which material has the lowest density?
Calculate the density of steel and say which materials float in water.
158 / 20 = 7.9 g/cm³. Oak and polystyrene float (below 1.0 g/cm³).
Explain why planes are built from aluminium and carbon fibre, not steel.
They have much lower density, so the plane is lighter: less lift is needed and less fuel is burned. Both are still strong.
